ADDITIONAL_TEST_COMMAND.description: Zero or more project-specific validation commands rendered as shell command lines.

COPYRIGHT_YEAR.description: Four-digit first-publication or current copyright year used by the MIT licence.

KNOWN_LIMITATION.description: Zero or more honest, user-visible limitations rendered as Markdown list items.

MAINTAINER_NAME.description: Person or organization responsible for maintained project decisions and conduct enforcement.

PROFILE_EVIDENCE.description: Minimum runtime evidence appropriate to the selected repository profile.

values.application: startup, shutdown, upgrade, recovery, packaging and end-to-end smoke evidence
values.library: public API, caller-contract and focused regression evidence
values.ui-component: UI state, cleanup, recovery, DPI/accessibility and lifecycle evidence

PROFILE_NAME.description: Human-readable name of the selected repository profile.

PROFILE_PURPOSE.description: Purpose boundary associated with the selected repository profile.

values.application: an end-to-end workbook or add-in solution that owns deployment and lifecycle
values.library: reusable callable VBA with no owned end-user shell
values.ui-component: an embeddable component that owns a bounded interactive surface

PROFILE_SOURCE_CONTRACT.description: Expected source layout associated with the selected repository profile.

values.application: modules, classes and the applicable workbook, form, Ribbon or host-lifecycle exports
values.library: public facade modules plus internal/core modules, with classes only when stateful objects are part of the API
values.ui-component: modules and classes, plus forms, Ribbon XML and host callbacks only when used

PROJECT_DESCRIPTION.description: One sentence stating the supported problem and audience without evidence claims.

PROJECT_NAME.description: Human-readable project name used in documentation and release text.

PROJECT_TAGLINE.description: Short identity line used below the project name.

REPOSITORY_PATH.description: GitHub owner/name path used by clone commands, badges and repository links.

SOCIAL_PREVIEW_PATH.description: Tracked repository-relative banner path; omitting it removes the complete banner block.

SUPPORT_CONTACT.description: Private security-reporting email address or maintained private reporting URL.
